blockers.description: worldSetsDistinct is not, as currently designed, an actual per-step loop invariant: (1) persistent rule firings (K boxPos, T self-prop, 4-rule box-itself propagation) add formulas to existing worlds' relevant sets without re-checking distinctness against other known worlds; (2) the minting guard (blockingWorld) checks the SOURCE world's uniqueness against existing worlds, not the freshly-minted world's prospective content, so a new world can be born already coinciding with an existing one. Full detail in plans/01_s4-loopchecking-termination-decidability.md Phase 8 BLOCKER note.
